description:
About our brand and products:

knēNest is a wellness-focused comfort brand created specifically for side sleepers. Our flagship product, the knēNest knee pillow, is designed around knee, hip, and spinal alignment to help side sleepers rest more comfortably throughout the night. Unlike ordinary pillows placed between the legs, knēNest features a unique center channel that naturally guides the knees into position while supporting better alignment and pressure relief. We are also expanding into a full side-sleeper comfort system, including ergonomic head, neck, shoulder, and ankle support products.

What makes us different:

knēNest is not just another generic knee pillow. It was designed with a knee-centered shape, supportive memory foam, and a distinctive center comfort channel that allows the knees to settle into the pillow rather than simply resting across the top. Our product was developed to solve common side-sleeping issues such as knee contact, hip rotation, and poor lower-body positioning. We focus on premium comfort, thoughtful design, and clear customer education so users understand proper placement and give their body time to adjust.

How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates can earn commissions by referring customers to knēNest through their unique affiliate link or code. Our products appeal to a wide audience because most people sleep on their side, and many are actively looking for better comfort, alignment, and sleep support. Affiliates can promote knēNest through social media, blogs, email newsletters, product reviews, wellness content, sleep-related content, and short-form videos. We provide a compelling product story, strong visual appeal, and a practical everyday solution that is easy to explain.

How to promote us:

The best way to promote knēNest is by focusing on real side-sleeper problems and the difference proper positioning can make. Affiliates should highlight how knēNest helps separate and support the knees, encourages knee, hip, and spinal alignment, and offers a more intentional design than ordinary pillows. Great content ideas include “side sleeper problems,” “why your knees hurt when sleeping on your side,” “better sleep positioning,” comparison posts, unboxing videos, before-and-after comfort stories, and product demonstrations showing correct placement in the center channel.

Other information:

knēNest is ideal for affiliates, wellness creators, sleep-focused influencers, chiropractors, health professionals, lifestyle bloggers, and anyone with an audience interested in better rest and everyday comfort. We encourage honest, educational, and compliant promotion that does not make exaggerated medical claims or promise guaranteed results for every customer. Our messaging should focus on side-sleeping comfort, alignment, pressure relief, thoughtful design, and helping customers understand how to use the product properly for the best experience.
payout_period: Eligible commissions are paid on the 1st of each month after the customer’s 60-day satisfaction guarantee period has passed. Orders must be final, non-refunded, and outside the return window before commissions are approved for payout.
